5.2 Imaging Modalities

-   X-ray
-   CT scan
-   MRI
-   Ultrasound
-   PET scan

Each modality has strengths and limitations.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

6. Infectious Diseases

6.1 Bacterial Infections

Examples: - Tuberculosis (Mycobacterium tuberculosis) - Streptococcal
pharyngitis - Sepsis

Antibiotic resistance is a major global concern.

6.2 Viral Infections

Examples: - Influenza - HIV - COVID-19

Vaccination remains the most effective preventive strategy.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

7. Public Health and Epidemiology

7.1 Epidemiological Measures

-   Incidence
-   Prevalence
-   Mortality rate
-   Case fatality rate

7.2 Disease Prevention

Levels: - Primary prevention (vaccination) - Secondary prevention
(screening) - Tertiary prevention (rehabilitation)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

8. Medical Ethics

Core principles: - Autonomy - Beneficence - Non-maleficence - Justice

Ethical dilemmas: - End-of-life care - Resource allocation - Informed
consent

------------------------------------------------------------------------

9. Emerging Medical Technologies

9.1 Artificial Intelligence in Medicine

Applications: - Medical imaging analysis - Clinical decision support -
Predictive analytics

Challenges: - Data bias - Explainability - Regulatory approval

9.2 Genomic Medicine

Technologies: - Whole genome sequencing - CRISPR gene editing

Ethical concerns include privacy and genetic discrimination.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

10. Long-Range Cross-Referencing Section (RAG Stress)

If a question asks: - “Which hormone mentioned in Section 2 affects
blood glucose?” → Insulin and glucagon - “Which disease in Section 1
involves dopaminergic neurons?” → Parkinson’s disease - “Which imaging
modality in Section 5 uses magnetic fields?” → MRI - “Which pharmacology
concept uses ADME?” → Pharmacokinetics

This section intentionally requires cross-document semantic retrieval.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
